notes: All of package D is procedural: one script, live/live.js (window.G20Live), no image assets. Every model number is in G20Live.PARAMS with {v, ev, src, note}; the fits that wrote them are bake/src/G20/live/*.py (build_params.py writes the PARAMS block). No photo pixels. Report: docs/G20SIM-D-live.md.

entries.notes: Our own seeded street layout (never BMW's data) inside map.region with the measured edge fade; background, road colours and widths per look from 08 (night) and 09 (day). Streets drift down at speed (m/s) * px_per_m (weak: 1 px/m). Drawn under B's semi-transparent dial faces.
Red chevron at map.position_arrow (fixed; the streets move).
Mirror of the tacho glow model; the speedo was only seen at 0 km/h. gain is for the lead to calibrate against B's faces (B's faces must not contain the pointer glow).
Fitted on the 08 (0) vs 09 (idle) difference with a per-channel exposure map; medium for 0..~1.7 x1000 (where both glows were seen), weak above.
Pink rev band inside the ticks from 0 to the pointer (seen at idle only; beyond 0.7 x1000 extrapolated along the ring: weak). No speedo band: never seen (speed 0 in every photo).
Position along the scale: strong (every tick measured, hits within 0.85 px). Travel in motion (orientation, length): weak, never photographed moving; at 0 km/h it matches 08/09/14 within 1-2 px.
Rays from one virtual centre (fits 0 and idle to 0.3 deg). Theme connected (14): a SHORT bar (109 px vs 187.5 stock). Travel beyond idle: weak.
Lit fill below the needle (moves with the value) and the tapered red needle. Seen only near f 0.84-0.87; the 0 and 1 ends of the ring are weak. Needles at the photos' levels within 1.3 px.
Mirror of the fuel mini. Seen at the notch (08/09, warm) and the cold end (14, COLD): within 1.9 px. The temperature range 70..150 degC is a guess (no numerals on the scale).
